description: The mongodb_flex spec documents only 200, 400, 401 and 500 on GetInstance, so a missing instance is untyped and read/delete can't tell missing from failed. The wire answers 404: STACKIT's own Terraform provider treats `http.StatusNotFound` from GetInstance as gone and removes the resource from state (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/mongodbflex/instance/resource.go, Read, read 2026-11-01). No live probe.
